title: D-091 T2: Linux launcher and bash shell-routing test harness for the loop (analog of the PowerShell launch and ps_tests)
objective: Give the loop a Linux launch path (a bash launcher and a systemd unit template, never started by an agent) and a bash shell-routing test harness equivalent to tools/agent_supervisor/ps_tests, wired through launch_seam.py, so the controller's shell-routing probe can be certified on Linux.
business_reason: Owner directive D-091: move the loop to the cloud server with Codex and Claude reviews and a combining model.
inputs: M0-T165 (accepted, merged in #288): os_acl.controller_config_acl_verdict, platform_paths, process.bare_probe_env / apply_posix_autoupdater_belt; its reports M0-T165-G3G4.md and M0-T165-G5.md (follow-ups N1)
outputs: tools/agent_supervisor/linux/ (launcher, systemd unit template, bash shell-routing harness and mutants)
cli.py doctor posture uses the cross-platform ACL verdict on Linux (fail-closed UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN)
capability_probe.py and native_runtime.py bare probes run with DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 on Linux; Windows unchanged
forbidden_paths: cli.py (3598 lines, above the modularity ceiling): only the call-site swap in _controller_config_acl_posture to os_acl.controller_config_acl_verdict, with no net growth; capability_probe.py and native_runtime.py: only passing the M0-T165 bare_probe_env()/apply_posix_autoupdater_belt() environment to the bare version/help probes; no other change in these three files
starting or commissioning a live loop, or any owner-typed step (runbook section 12)
codex login or handling any owner credential
weakening any fail-closed check, gate, reviewer-independence rule or the orchestrator's sole authority (ADR-005)
Windows behavior changes: existing Windows paths and tests must keep passing unchanged
acceptance_scenarios: primary: the bash harness runs the same shell-routing cases as ps_tests and passes on this server
boundary: each mutant in the bash harness is detected (the harness goes red)
missing/ambiguous: a missing claude binary or unset required env fails closed before any provider contact
failure: the launcher refuses to start when the start gate refuses; it never pushes, merges or starts a live run in tests

wiring: on Linux the doctor posture reports the POSIX verdict (PROTECTED / NOT_PROTECTED / UNKNOWN with reasons); on Windows it is byte-unchanged; the bare probes on Linux carry DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 and on Windows keep env=None
risks: recertification: every tools/agent_supervisor/** edit invalidates the frozen certification; one recertification task runs after all D-091 code tasks
